notes.title: Longshot Universe Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Our plan at this point is to release LSU on Tuesday, April 25th just before Midnight Pacific Coast Time.

Please tell your friends and get in the fight together!  We look forward to seeing everyone online!

-- Longshot Studios.
